notes.title: Big Overhaul Coming Soon
notes.content:
Sorry for the lack of updates I've been working on a very big [b]overhaul[/b] that will be released in the coming weeks that will address the majority of the issues people have with the game and make it more of what it was originally supposed to be.
The update will include:
-Brand new more, responsive and smarter AI system
-Brand new UI System
-Updated Graphics
-More things to sell
-More ways to sell
-Specialty stores
-New content such as armed robberies
-Much More!
This update I plana on releasing on or before January 21st

Thanks and have fun!
-Nick

notes.title: Update 2
notes.content:
Just a small update with bug fixes, there will be a large content update later this week:

- Fixed deleting items bugs
- Improved pathfinding
- Added Chips
- Layed down framework for new content
- General bug fixes

For more info on development of Supermarket Tycoon & Sneak Thief follow @sneakthiefgame on twitter

notes.title: Update 1 - Launch Fixes
notes.content:
This update is basically addressing most of the bugs and complaints about the game on launch day that I previously paid no mind to or did not notice,

- Zooming in and out added
- Customers no longer spawn if your store is empty
- Added basic settings menu for graphics and audio in game
- Fixed basic bugs
- Improved Anti-Aliasing 
- General Improvements to AI

notes.title: WE WON THE DMCA
notes.content: For those of you who don't know the game had been taken down for copyright infringment. However it has now been lifted! Thanks to all of you we won the case! More details on it coming soon but in the meantime have fun!
